x: He has a massive talent but in recent years we’ve only seen the palest shadow of the real DA. During the summer he turned out on the track when we’d been desperate but there’s a limit to how much a man can dutifully put into his training when he gets so little success in return.
And welcome back to the racing fold to DA! His Surrey League race was an absolute beaut, and we’re all delighted he seems finally to be on top of his Achilles problems.
In SS, DA, Wicksy and Jon, we have four master-blasters who form the foundation upon which our teams are built, with an average age of just 25.
